blocks.text: 🪝 Government to Offload up to 6.5% Stake in LIC via Offer for Sale (OFS). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Disinvestment of **2.5% base equity** with an additional **4% greenshoe option** (total up to 6.5%).
Floor price fixed at **₹382 per share**.
Centre currently holds 96.5% stake in LIC.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
